descricao: CLI that tidies up messy folders by reading file contents with an LLM, not just extensions: it picks the folder by topic, suggests better names and shows the plan before touching anything (with undo). Runs on Claude or on a free local model via Ollama (gemma3:4b). Uses structured outputs with a Pydantic schema, batching, image reading, and treats model output as untrusted input. Automated tests and CI.

Diagnostic instrument for the maturity of technical resources for AI adoption in small businesses. In 20 questions and about 10 minutes, it assesses infrastructure, data, tools and skills, and returns each resource's level and the order to invest in. Artifact of an applied research project (Design Science Research) at PUCPR. Runs entirely in the browser, sending no data.

This website: an isometric pixel art bedroom where each object tells part of my story. Built by orchestrating AI agents (Claude Code) by area — art, scene, interface, content and QA — with ADRs, tests and accessibility. The art is generated by code.

Automatic class attendance with GPS presence validation: the teacher opens a roll call with a radius and the backend checks the student's distance (Haversine formula), with a manual request when GPS fails. Validated with 20 interviews over two Lean Startup cycles. AI used as support for prototypes, code and review. Built as a team at PUCPR.
